quality_check.description: A clean vertical hand-drawn object reference sheet on a plain warm cream background. It shows two large views of the same smoky clear glass orb: a standalone upper view and a lower view seated in an aged-bronze cradle. The orb has a narrow dark bronze equatorial band, a small moss-green cord knot, subtle amber rim glints, and a neutral empty smoky interior. The cradle has three small claw-like supports, a prominent crescent-shaped side brace, and a low oval base. No people, raven, room elements, labels, arrows, or text are visible.

The sphere contour is fairly regular and polished; the requested subtle hand-crafted imperfection is present only weakly.

prompt:
Create a clean 9:16 object reference sheet for one recurring magic orb. Show two large views: the orb
alone and the orb on its low asymmetrical aged-bronze cradle. Locked identity: slightly smoky clear
sphere, subtle imperfect hand-crafted contour, narrow bronze equatorial band, three small claw-like
supports, one crescent-shaped side brace, tiny moss-green cord knot, restrained dim amber rim glints.
The interior is neutral smoky glass with no scene so each episode can supply its own topic world.
Plain warm background, no crone, raven, hands, room, labels, text, arrows, extra objects, 3D CGI or
photorealism; premium hand-drawn object turnaround with clear silhouette.
